title: ST-5addldcn's sibling stop is proven by a planted landing run, not a count of calls in the source
goal: The proof that land stops at step siblings runs bl_land.land_siblings on a planted backlog (a done in-sprint item sharing a file with a failing check, a done item of another sprint, a todo item and a kb/_self-only share) and reads that only the first is named and the landing stops; no new test file (the check is the proof). Found by the SP-4cc36epy review (S4, ST-5addldcn "land reruns the done checks of sprint siblings"): its check 1 only counts calls of rerun_sibling_checks in bl_land.py.

run:
import json,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P,subprocess as s
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land
r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());s.run(['git','init','-q',str(r)],check=True)
d=r/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog';d.mkdir(parents=True)
def w(i,**k):(d/(i+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'id':i,'priority':'P3','title':'t',**k},indent=2)+'\n')
w('SP-aaaaaaaa',kind='sprint',status='active',goal='g');w('SP-bbbbbbbb',kind='sprint',status='active',goal='g')
F=[{'run':['python3','-c','import sys;sys.exit(1)']}]
w('ST-aaaaaaaa',kind='story',status='done',sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa',goal='g',touches=['x.txt'],checks=F)
w('ST-dddddddd',kind='story',status='done',sprint='SP-bbbbbbbb',goal='g',touches=['x.txt'],checks=F)
w('ST-eeeeeeee',kind='story',status='todo',sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa',goal='g',touches=['x.txt'],checks=F)
w('ST-ffffffff',kind='story',status='done',sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa',goal='g',touches=['kb/_self/tools.md'],checks=F)
w('ST-cccccccc',kind='story',status='doing',sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa',goal='g',touches=['x.txt','kb/_self/tools.md'],checks=[])
bl=bl_land.Backlog(r);named=[x[0] for x in bl_land.rerun_sibling_checks(bl,'ST-cccccccc')]
try:bl_land.land_siblings(bl,'ST-cccccccc');stopped=False
except Exception as e:stopped='step siblings' in str(e)
print(named,stopped);sys.exit(0 if named==['ST-aaaaaaaa'] and stopped else 1)

notes: Its check passes on the 2026-10-17 tip: the behaviour holds; the story only keeps the planted proof, so planning may drop it.
